headline_result: For any exact-rank-two crossing between two genuine independent product banks, arbitrary same-bank phases and independent background are harmless: |phi(t)|<=min(1,2pi(s1s2)^(-1/2)|t|^-1), so the full output has ||p||_2^2<=4(s1s2)^(-1/2), weighted whole-copy integral <=(16/3)sqrt(2pi)(s1s2)^(-1/4), whole-copy half-Riesz <=(16/3)(s1s2)^(-1/4), and one-copy quarter-Riesz <=4(s1s2)^(-1/8). On the live exact-rank-two E2(N)>4/9 branch these are uniform even as s2->0. A literal hyperbola peel then converts the quarter-potential to a linear one-copy small-ball bound with coefficient 5.413640|mu|^-3/4(s1s2)^-1/8 when structurally available.
unresolved_implication: In the live exact-rank-two E2 chamber, combine the uniform aggregate quarter-Riesz credit with the deterministic anchored Schur/internal-star currency to obtain the missing one-copy quarter-power without selecting a tiny physical minor or dividing by s2.
next_step: Try a grouped-star or Pluecker-weighted hyperbola peel that spends the rank-two singular product globally and the anchored currency only for the final quarter-power.
